links.outcome: Fabricated evidence in LLM variant interpretation, with and without execution of validated code
links.effect: Fabricated evidence is measurable and is neutralised by execution; dangerous misclassification is rare and model-invariant.
links.quote: First, dangerous misclassification is rare and model-invariant, a controlled precondition of the executed architecture rather than a frontier, while fabricated evidence is measurable and is neutralised by execution.

unlisted_practices: Fail-closed evidence contract that blocks evidence circular with the truth label
Temporally blinded truth set with labels first available after every model's training cutoff
Attributing failures to the architectural layer that produced them, including end-to-end join across variant calling and interpretation
Constraining agentic LLMs toward executed, validated code, with pinning, provenance and auditability

screen.practice: constraint gradient toward validated code execution with fail-closed evidence contract
screen.reason: The study benchmarks agentic LLMs on clinical genomic variant interpretation and evaluates specific safety guardrails (a fail-closed evidence contract and validated code execution) for neutralizing fabricated evidence and dangerous misclassifications.

primary.practice: fail-closed evidence contract and validated code execution guardrails
